text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of boys enrolled in school, by education level
Shown for each level of education as the gross enrollment ratio — the number of boys, regardless of their age,
who are enrolled at that level of education, expressed as a percentage of the official school-age population of

tspan.tspan: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), via World Bank (2026); UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026)
Values may exceed 100% when children who are older or younger than the official age group also enroll.
